title: From Mount Whitney to the valley
text: The Kern River is approximately 165 miles long. It is fed by snowmelt near Mount Whitney and begins in the Sierra Nevada in Sequoia National Park. In Lake Isabella, the Kern is joined by its largest tributary, the 95-mile South Fork. Below Lake Isabella, the river feeds several hydroelectric plants.
